title: Building blocks shared by all files

id.description: A short code for this item. Use only small letters, digits and dashes, no spaces. Example: data-science

text.description: Text that people read. Write it once per language: en for English, el for Greek. Example: { "en": "Databases", "el": "Βάσεις Δεδομένων" }. One language is enough.

date.description: A date written as year-month-day. Example: 2026-10-05

academic_year.description: Two years joined by a dash. Example: 2026-2027

url.description: A web address starting with https://

person_ref.description: A person's id from faculty.json. Example: smith-john. For a person in another department, write the department first: mathematics:euler-leo

course_ref.description: A course code. Example: 3117. For a course of another department write the department first: cs:3117. For a postgraduate programme of that department: cs/msc-data-science:DS501. For its undergraduate courses when the code alone is unclear: cs/undergraduate:3117

ects.description: Number of ECTS credits (a number such as 6 or 7.5)
